qualification.details: Accountant-cum-Clerk: Graduate with knowledge of accounts and working knowledge of computers. Doctor (Full Time) Rural: MBBS with registration with medical council / medical commission and should undergo training arranged by the MOSJE / NISD within three months of joining the IRCA. Yoga therapist/ Dance Teacher/Music Teacher/Art Teacher (Part Time): Diploma in Yoga/ Dance/Music with three (03) years of experience in the discipline. Nurse: A qualified nurse with GNM/ B.Sc. Nursing degree and should be willing to be trained by the agency, as decided by MSJ&E. Peer Educator: Should be literate; Ex-drug user with 1-2 years of sobriety. Willing to work among drug using population and having communication skills. Agrees to refrain from using, buying, or selling drugs; Ready to work for the prevention of harmful drug use and relapse.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the North & Middle Andaman District Mayabunder recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the various posts released by North & Middle Andaman District Mayabunder is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the North & Middle Andaman District Mayabunder recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for various posts, including Accountant-cum-Clerk, Doctor, Nurse, and others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Accountant-cum-Clerk post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Accountant-cum-Clerk post is a Graduate degree with knowledge of accounts and working knowledge of computers.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Doctor (Full Time) Rural post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Doctor (Full Time) Rural post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Nurse position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Nurse position is Rs. 15,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes application verification, display of eligible candidates' list, and an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website: www.andaman.gov.in, https://northmiddle.andaman.nic.in/.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. What is the address to send the application form?
faq.answer: The application should be sent to The Project Coordinator-cum-Vocational Counsellor, Integrated Rehabilitation Centre for Addicts (IRCAs), Near Gram Panchayat Office Pokadera, Danapur, North & Middle Andaman District, Mayabunder-744204.
